summary: REQ-1 appears implemented in AppHeader: when authenticated it shows a "User ID:" label with the principal formatted via the existing formatPrincipal helper, and it is responsive (desktop inline; mobile shown inside the dropdown). No user ID is rendered when not authenticated. There are also modifications to metadata/state summary files that were not requested in the BuildRequest.

hallucinated_features.description: Modified project tracking/metadata state (project_state.json) unrelated to implementing the header user ID display.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asks to display the logged-in user's principal in the app header; it does not request updating project tracking/state files.

hallucinated_features.description: Updated/added extensive frontend file summary content (frontend-file-summaries.txt) unrelated to the single header user-ID change.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not request generating or modifying documentation/summary files.
